blocks.text: Yeh chapter computational thinking, yani masail qadam ba qadam hal karne ke tareeqe, se mantiq tak gaya jo haqaiq pesh karne aur un par istidlal ka durust tareeqa hai. Table is ki bunyadi istilahat ikatthi karti hai.

blocks.caption: Chapter 2 ki kaleedi istilahat
rows: Computational thinking
Masla samajhna, chhote hisson mein torna aur mantiqi soch se qadam ba qadam hal karna
Decomposition
Bare ya pecheeda masle ko chhote, qabil-e-intizam hisson mein torna
Algorithm
Masla hal karne ya kaam karne ki qadam ba qadam hidayat
Logic
Durust istidlal aur faislon ke liye haqaiq, statements aur qawaid pesh karne ka rasmi tareeqa
Proposition
Statement jo ya sach ya jhoot ho, dono nahi
Compound proposition
AND, OR ya NOT se jure do ya zyada saade propositions
Truth table
Inputs ke har milap par expression ki truth values ka table
Propositional equivalence
Do expressions ki har soorat mein aik si truth values
Propositional satisfiability
Proposition satisfiable hai agar kam az kam aik soorat mein sach ho
Predicate logic
Mozoo, sifaat, variables aur rishton se statements pesh karne wali mantiq
Predicate
Mozoo ki sifat ya rishta bayan karne wala expression
Quantifier
Batata hai statement kitni ashya par lagta hai: for all, ya there exists
Logical inference
Diye gaye haqaiq se durust nateeja nikalna
Deduction
Aam qawaid ya maloom haqaiq se khaas nateeja nikalna

items: Computational thinking: decomposition, naqsh, abstraction, algorithms, jaanch.
Propositional logic: propositions, connectives, truth tables, equivalence, satisfiability.
Predicate logic: predicates, variables, quantifiers, inference aur deduction.
